title: MCPGen: Benchmarking LLMs on Executable MCPWorkflow Development
abstract: arXiv:2609.23925v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study whether LLMs can produce executable workflow artifacts that remain consistent across graph structure, tool implementation, schema bindings, and runtime wiring. In this setting, correctness depends on cross-layer consistency: a workflow may be structurally plausible, yet still fail because tool implementations, schema bindings, or runtime execution do not align. Existing benchmarks largely evaluate these capabilities in isolation or rely on trajectory-level proxies, leaving open whether generated workflow artifacts execute end-to-end. We introduce \textbf{MCPGen}, an executable benchmark for Model Context Protocol (MCP) workflow development. MCPGen contains 100 self-contained MCP projects across 16 application domains and evaluates three diagnostic tasks: workflow reconstruction, tool creation, and backward-compatible workflow extension. translated_title: MCPGen：面向可执行MCP工作流开发的LLM基准测试
translated_abstract: 我们研究大语言模型（LLM）能否生成在图结构、工具实现、模式绑定和运行时连接等各层面保持一致的可执行工作流产物。在这种设定下，正确性取决于跨层一致性：一个工作流可能在结构上看似合理，但仍可能因工具实现、模式绑定或运行时执行不匹配而失败。现有基准测试大多孤立地评估这些能力，或依赖轨迹层面的代理指标，未能回答生成的工作流产物能否端到端执行这一问题。我们提出了MCPGen，一个用于模型上下文协议（MCP）工作流开发的可执行基准测试。MCPGen包含覆盖16个应用领域的100个自包含MCP项目，并评估三项诊断任务：工作流重构、工具创建以及向后兼容的工作流扩展。我们在单轮基础模型设定下评估了11个具有代表性的LLM，考察其生成能力。
tldr: 该论文提出了MCPGen——一个针对MCP工作流开发的可执行基准测试，通过覆盖16个应用领域的100个自包含项目和三项诊断任务，评估LLM能否生成具备跨层一致性、可端到端执行的工作流产物。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MCPGen, an executable benchmark for MCP workflow development, featuring 100 self-contained projects across 16 domains and three diagnostic tasks to evaluate whether LLMs can generate end-to-end executable workflows with cross-layer consistency.
